name: Example Public Dataterm Host

securitySheaf.label: Probe-6
securitySheaf.effect: The grid-provider kiosk checks the decker's public-account context, payment trail, and local access path.

securitySheaf.label: Probe-8
securitySheaf.effect: A stronger provider-side credential audit starts comparing the icon to normal public terminal users.

securitySheaf.label: Scout-6
securitySheaf.effect: A patrol routine maps what subsystem the intruder is touching and marks abnormal use for escalation.

encounter.consequence: Scout IC may identify which records, logs, or device controls were touched. Notify the GM if unresolved.

securitySheaf.label: Trace-8
securitySheaf.effect: Provider trace tape starts crawling back toward the decker's access route.

securitySheaf.label: Passive Alert
securitySheaf.effect: The dataterm host enters Passive Alert. Subsystem ratings may effectively rise under alert conditions; public users still see a normal kiosk.

encounter.consequence: Passive Alert: grid-provider monitoring or local terminal flags may become active. Notify the GM if unresolved.

securitySheaf.label: Probe-6 with Killer-8 Trap
securitySheaf.effect: A familiar provider audit window hides a hostile trap routine.

encounter.consequence: Trap-loaded Killer IC engaged from the dataterm sheaf. Resolve damage/consequences per the table's SR3 Matrix handling.

securitySheaf.label: Trace-8 with Blaster-8 Trap
securitySheaf.effect: The trace path bites back with a hostile trap routine as it tries to pin the decker's origin.

encounter.consequence: Trap-loaded Blaster IC engaged from the dataterm sheaf. Resolve damage/consequences per the table's SR3 Matrix handling.

sculpting: A public grid-provider kiosk: transit maps, civic-service menus, pay-per-use prompts, local-grid notices, user-session receipts, terminal maintenance panels, camera eyes, privacy-booth curtains, and trace tape spooling toward the jackpoint.
notes: Generic SSG public dataterm host for Mevin Decker Experience. Green-4 profile with public local-grid information, protected recent-user/session logs, activity records, terminal device controls, and GM-fill prompts for exact local contents.

nodes.title: Public Dataterm Kiosk
nodes.description: You are at a generic public dataterm: a grid-provider terminal with public services on the front and protected local records beneath. It can stand in for a street corner, mall, library, transit stop, post office, store, restaurant, or club terminal.

nodes.title: Public Local Grid Menu
nodes.description: The public side offers normal citizen-facing services: local maps, transit, weather, civic forms, public feeds, directory search, paid calls, print/fax queues, and basic Matrix access. This is legal-use material unless the GM says otherwise.

choices.label: Browse local grid map and public feeds

nodes.title: Local Grid Public Information
nodes.description: You get public local-grid information: nearby LTG context, map/search references, transit routes, weather/service notices, and public directory data. Tell the GM you have public local-grid info; ask what local facts this terminal can reveal.

report.title: Public local-grid information
report.detail: Mevin used a public dataterm for local-grid info. GM fills in nearby LTG context, maps, transit, service notices, directory data, or public feeds.

nodes.title: Civic and Service Menus
nodes.description: You find public civic forms, payment portals, service directories, emergency info, and provider-branded citizen services. Tell the GM you have public civic/service context; ask what applies here.

report.title: Public civic/service menus
report.detail: Mevin used a public dataterm for civic/service menus. GM fills in public forms, service directories, payment portals, emergency info, or provider notices.

nodes.title: Neighborhood Notices
nodes.description: You find public neighborhood notices: lost-and-found posts, event listings, local warnings, ads, outage notices, or vandalism reports. Tell the GM you have public neighborhood-notice access; ask what is relevant.

report.title: Public neighborhood notices
report.detail: Mevin used a public dataterm for neighborhood notices. GM fills in public warnings, events, ads, outage notices, vandalism reports, or local postings.

nodes.title: Provider Access Gate
nodes.description: Behind the public kiosk is the grid provider's protected surface: recent user sessions, activity logs, terminal devices, maintenance records, privacy-booth controls, and anti-tamper status.

nodes.title: Protected Dataterm Records Hub
nodes.description: Session receipts, recent-user shadows, local-grid searches, vidphone call trails, print/fax/cache records, credstick checks, and maintenance tickets sort themselves into provider filing slots.

nodes.title: Recent Users and Account Traces
nodes.description: You appear to have recent-user and account-trace access: public handles, payment/account crumbs, login windows, jackpoint sessions, and possibly repeated users. Tell the GM; ask who used this dataterm recently and what identifiers are visible.

report.title: Recent dataterm users
report.detail: Mevin reached recent-user/account traces on a public dataterm. GM fills in handles, account crumbs, login windows, repeated users, or identifier limits.

choices.label: Log off with recent-user access noted

nodes.title: Recent Activities and Session History
nodes.description: You appear to have activity-log access: vidphone calls, Matrix sessions, public account use, print/fax jobs, chip/CD reads, scanner jobs, credstick checks, and temporary cache artifacts. Tell the GM; ask what recent activity matters.

report.title: Recent dataterm activity
report.detail: Mevin reached recent activity/session history on a public dataterm. GM fills in calls, sessions, print/fax jobs, chip/CD reads, scanner jobs, credstick checks, or cache artifacts.

choices.label: Log off with activity access noted

nodes.title: Local Search and Public-Service Activity
nodes.description: You appear to have local search and public-service activity records: maps queried, local directories searched, civic forms opened, service requests, transit lookups, and emergency info views. Tell the GM; ask what this reveals about the target or neighborhood.

report.title: Local search/public-service activity
report.detail: Mevin reached local search/public-service activity records. GM fills in maps, directories, forms, service requests, transit lookups, or emergency-info views.

choices.label: Log off with search activity noted

nodes.title: Maintenance, Vandalism, and Outage Logs
nodes.description: You appear to have maintenance logs: provider technician visits, anti-tamper alarms, vandalism reports, broken peripherals, outage windows, and suspicious service history. Tell the GM; ask what has happened to this dataterm recently.

report.title: Dataterm maintenance/vandalism logs
report.detail: Mevin reached dataterm maintenance, vandalism, anti-tamper, and outage logs. GM fills in service history and suspicious maintenance clues.

choices.label: Log off with maintenance logs noted

nodes.title: Paydata: Recent User Pattern
nodes.description: You copy modest recent-user pattern paydata: repeated handles, login windows, payment/account crumbs, or evidence that one person has been using this terminal as a routine touchpoint. Tell the GM; exact contents and value are GM-filled.

report.title: Recent-user pattern paydata
report.detail: Mevin copied recent-user pattern paydata from a public dataterm. GM determines exact contents, value, and consequences.

nodes.title: Paydata: Recent Activity Trail
nodes.description: You copy modest recent-activity paydata: session history, vidphone/call traces, print/fax jobs, credstick checks, or cached activity that points somewhere useful. Tell the GM; exact contents and value are GM-filled.

report.title: Recent-activity paydata
report.detail: Mevin copied recent-activity paydata from a public dataterm. GM determines exact contents, value, and consequences.

nodes.title: Terminal Device Controls
nodes.description: The physical dataterm appears as a utility cabinet: camera eye, privacy-booth lock, panic-button light, display/speaker panels, printer/fax/scanner tray, credstick reader, wireless node, and anti-tamper mesh.

choices.label: Privacy booth lock, panic button, and anti-tamper status

nodes.title: Camera / Booth Monitoring Access
nodes.description: You appear to have camera, microphone, or booth monitoring access. Tell the GM; confirm whether this dataterm has cameras, what area they cover, whether recordings exist, and whether live monitoring is possible.

report.title: Dataterm camera/booth monitoring
report.detail: Mevin reached dataterm camera/booth monitoring. GM confirms camera/mic presence, coverage, recordings, and live-monitoring limits.

nodes.title: Printer / Fax / Scanner / Display Controls
nodes.description: You appear to have peripheral access: display, speaker, printer, fax, scanner, chip/CD reader, or local cache. Tell the GM; confirm what physical functions and stored artifacts exist.

report.title: Dataterm peripheral controls
report.detail: Mevin reached dataterm peripheral controls. GM confirms display/speaker/printer/fax/scanner/chip-reader functions and cache artifacts.

nodes.title: Privacy Booth / Panic / Anti-Tamper Status
nodes.description: You appear to have privacy booth, panic-button, lock, and anti-tamper status access. Tell the GM; confirm whether a booth exists, lock state, panic events, tamper alarms, and whether bypassing anything triggers provider or local security response.

report.title: Dataterm booth/panic/anti-tamper status
report.detail: Mevin reached privacy booth, panic button, lock, and anti-tamper status. GM confirms booth presence, lock state, panic events, tamper alarms, and response risks.

choices.label: Log off before provider tamper review

nodes.title: Leave the Public Dataterm
nodes.description: You drop back into local Matrix traffic, leaving the public kiosk behind. Current-crawl lockouts are not permanent unless the GM says so; reset and retry after appropriate in-world time if allowed.
